spec.name: Orange Kitchen Dough Bench
spec.description: A maple bakery cabinet with a thick flour-dusted worktop, paneled storage, a handled rolling pin, soft stepped dough and a small upright dough scraper. Front faces -Z; feet rest at y0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Dough Bench. Bakery cabinet with flour-dusted thick maple worktop, wooden rolling pin with tapered handles and a little dough scraper. Main cabinet collision footprint x0..16,y0..16,z0..16, front -Z. Cooktop props may extend to y25.
